scenicChapters.title: Utah Scenic Byway 12
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 27 km this is Utah Scenic Byway 12, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

road-scenic-byway-12.story: From Panguitch it runs 374 km to Panguitch; allow about 6 h 14 of riding. It goes by way of Bryce Canyon City, Escalante, Boulder and Torrey. The highest point is about 2,650 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
